mods.description:
The mods that are on, in load order, then the mods that are off, by name.
Options are only counted here; `ModDetail` has them in full.

id.description: A stable id for the game, such as `hitman-woa`.

store.description: Where it was found: Steam, Epic Games, Microsoft Store or Folder.

kind.description: What the mod mostly changes. Information only: it never changes what loads.

position.description: 1-based place in the load order; absent when the mod is off.

badge.description: A short framework-specific label, such as `RPKG`.

problem.description: Why the mod's own description can't be read. Such a mod can't be turned on.

optionCount.description: How many options the mod has, and how many are chosen.

replacedBy.description:
Enabled mods later in the order that replace a file this one also
replaces, so their copy is used.

ModSummary.description:
One mod in a list: what an overview needs, short at any size. A mod can
have thousands of options, so the list counts them, and `ModDetail`
(`vmm mod <id>`, MCP `get_mod`) gives the mod in full.

ModKind.description:
What a mod mostly changes, for grouping the Mods view. Information only:
it never affects what the framework loads.

oneOf.description: Worked out from the mod's files.

KindSource.description: Where a mod's type comes from.
